mapper.select: SELECT internship_id as internshipId, student_id as studentId, company as company, position_name as positionName, time_period as timePeriod, experience_desc as experienceDesc, create_time as createTime FROM internship_experience WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM internship_experience WHERE internship_id = #{internshipId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
